name: fylgja-lab-peek
description: Experiment: read a Fylgja record without leaving the conversation. Links to records in Claude's replies and pasted references get a chip with a hover card, a click opens the record in a pane beside the transcript, and /peek opens the same pane by hand. It only draws and reads: nothing is added to what Claude reads and no prompt is delayed.

replyLinks.title: Links in replies
replyLinks.description: "pressable" (default): a reply that cites Fylgja records is drawn by this plugin, so a click on a citation opens the peek pane. "engine": Claude Code keeps drawing the reply and its links open as they always do; only the chips under the reply open the pane.
